"""L10M-ORACLE-3 conservative closed-loop candidate policy."""


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def decide(observation, memory):
    """Apply safety gating, target confirmation, hysteretic reacquisition, and direct steering."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})
    state = memory.get("state", "IDLE")
    last_turn = memory.get("last_turn", "")

    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    distance = observation["target_distance_class"]
    target_conf = float(observation["target_confidence"])
    identity_conf = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])
    track_age = int(observation["track_age"])
    lost_steps = int(observation["lost_steps"])
    safety = float(observation["safety_confidence"])
    closing_risk = float(observation["closing_risk"])

    if safety < 0.60 or closing_risk >= 0.75:
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        return "STOP", 0.99, memory

    confirmed = visible and target_conf >= 0.55 and identity_conf >= 0.60
    if not confirmed:
        memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE" if state in {
            "LOCKED", "APPROACH", "VERIFY", "REACQUIRE"
        } or lost_steps else "SEARCH"
        if lost_steps <= 1:
            return "STOP", 0.93, memory
        direction = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")
        if lost_steps % 3 == 0:
            direction = "SCAN_RIGHT" if direction == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
            memory["scan_direction"] = direction
        return direction, 0.76, memory

    if track_age < 2:
        memory["state"] = "VERIFY"
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80, memory

    if distance == "near":
        if abs(float(observation["heading_error"])) <= 15.0 and identity_conf >= 0.80:
            memory["state"] = "ARRIVED"
            return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory
        turn = "VEER_LEFT" if bearing < 0 else "VEER_RIGHT"
        memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
        memory["last_turn"] = turn
        return turn, 0.88, memory

    # A small deadband plus one-step hysteresis prevents needless zig-zagging.
    if bearing < -10.0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        action = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif bearing > 10.0 and observation["corridor_right"]:
        action = "VEER_RIGHT"
    elif abs(bearing) <= 14.0 and last_turn in {"VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"}:
        action = last_turn if abs(bearing) > 6.0 else "FORWARD"
    elif observation["corridor_center"]:
        action = "FORWARD"
    elif observation["corridor_left"]:
        action = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif observation["corridor_right"]:
        action = "VEER_RIGHT"
    else:
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        return "STOP", 0.98, memory

    memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
    if action in {"VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"}:
        memory["last_turn"] = action
    return action, 0.90 if action == "FORWARD" else 0.84, memory
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
